The successful candidate combines proven experience in high-stakes 24x7 environments, demonstrated technical aptitude, and excellent customer-facing skills. Drive automation efforts to reduce toil and extend observability in your focus area. Work directly with customers to understand how best to support their use cases, driving reliability and performance. Bring the voice of the customer to product and platform teams to ensure we deliver the services and features they need. Solid understanding of network technologies including VLANs, VXLAN, OSPF, BGP, NSX or similar SDN technologies, routing, switching, and load balancing. Core Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with high attention to detail. Effective at prioritizing and executing tasks in a high-pressure environment. Strong customer service orientation and a demonstrated willingness to help internal and external stakeholders. Highly self-motivated and directed, with a bias toward ownership and outcomes. Continuous improvement mindset; proactively automates and eliminates operational toil. Travel to data centers for cluster commissioning, acceptance, and complex troubleshooting will be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
